name: BabyDoge FarmZAP arbitrary-farm and auto-liquidity manipulation
summary: FarmZAP accepted any caller-supplied farm and gave it an unlimited approval on the swap output; since the zap was exempt from BabyDoge's transfer fees, this gave the attacker fee-free moves of flash-bought BabyDoge. It crashed the PancakeSwap price, triggered BabyDoge's unbounded swapAndLiquify sell into it, bought back and sold on BabyDogeSwap.
notes: FarmZAP's open farm approval only grants fee-free BabyDoge transfers once the zap is fee-exempt; the token owner's excludeFromFee(zap), about seven hours after the zap's deployment, is the latest change the exploit needed.

The 2023-06-21 transaction repeats the swapAndLiquify sandwich through another fee-exempt BabyDoge helper (AddRemoveLiquidityForFeeOnTransferTokens) instead of FarmZAP. A scan of every SwapAndLiquify event for sells far below neighbouring prices finds only these two.

Loss is the WBNB the BabyDogeSwap pair lost, netted per transaction with the PancakeSwap pair and the token contract, whose BabyDoge moves cancel; flash-loan fees the attacker paid out of it are not subtracted.
